mapper.select: SELECT vp.id, vp.project_id, vp.name, vp.create_time, vp.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = vp.id) AS total_cases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = vp.id AND pc.result = '成功') AS success_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = vp.id AND pc.result = '失败') AS fail_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = vp.id AND pc.result = '未执行') AS unexecuted_count FROM version_plan vp WHERE vp.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY vp.create_time DESC, vp.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO version_plan (project_id, name, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
